verification_report.summary:
The candidate proof passes sequential verification, with its retained-model conclusions conditional on the stated hypotheses R, F, I, C, and E. No critical errors or mathematical gaps were found.

Lemmas 1–5 correctly establish the coordinate identification, radial homeomorphism, integral homology, simple connectedness, face incidences, duality, symmetry orders, Coxeter presentation, and normalization scale. The external coordinate assertion matches [Baez, The Icosians](https://arxiv.org/html/1712.06436v2). The cited orbit result and theorem identifier match [Choi–Lee, Theorem 2](https://pdfs.semanticscholar.org/0fef/c9c8c31093da12262c8f6740da46c0dfb46e.pdf), with compatible unit-quaternion definitions. No arXiv theorem-search tool was callable; the supplied search results were considered and public-web fallback verified the references directly.

The supplied geometry checker was inspected without execution. Its exact arithmetic, supporting-facet tests, incidence checks, and stated limitations are correctly explained; the proof separately supplies facet completeness, topology, and the symmetry upper bound.

Lemmas 6–8 correctly justify signatures, hosting sets, piece equivariance, transported frames, the chronological multiplication law, and the independent ambient invariant index 2^43·5^2. The census totals agree. Lemmas 9–11 correctly derive independent alternating actions from complete pure-controller hypotheses, the balanced-color count without an extra factor of two, and the counting consequences. The stated integer comparisons were independently recomputed using exact integer arithmetic and hold.

Lemmas 12–15 correctly establish normalization and trivial intersection using the geometric center realization and spanning poles, distinguish normalization from metric preservation, justify symmetry-path lifting, prove complete endpoint transport including collateral, and establish setup-distance monotonicity when legal inverses are added. The collateral and commutation examples are valid. The final theorem retains all required hypotheses and scope limits, without claiming cut reconstruction, invariant sufficiency, an exact legal-group order, or numerical performance improvements.
